#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <algorithm>
#include <climits>
#include <cstring>
#include <ctime>

using namespace std;

struct Edge {
    int to, rev, cap, flow, cost;
    Edge(int to, int rev, int cap, int cost) : to(to), rev(rev), cap(cap), flow(0), cost(cost) {}
};

vector<vector<Edge>> graph;
int n;

void addEdge(int s, int t, int cap, int cost) {
    graph[s].emplace_back(t, graph[t].size(), cap, cost);
    graph[t].emplace_back(s, graph[s].size() - 1, 0, -cost);
}

void bellmanFord(int s, int dist[], int prevNode[], int prevEdge[], int curFlow[]) {
    fill(dist, dist + n, INT_MAX);
    dist[s] = 0;
    curFlow[s] = INT_MAX;
    bool inQ[n];
    memset(inQ, false, sizeof(inQ));
    int q[n];
    int qt = 0;
    q[qt++] = s;
    for (int qh = 0; (qh - qt) % n != 0; qh++) {
        int u = q[qh % n];
        inQ[u] = false;
        for (int i = 0; i < (int)graph[u].size(); i++) {
            Edge &e = graph[u][i];
            if (e.flow >= e.cap) continue;
            int v = e.to;
            int nd = dist[u] + e.cost;
            if (dist[v] > nd) {
                dist[v] = nd;
                prevNode[v] = u;
                prevEdge[v] = i;
                curFlow[v] = min(curFlow[u], e.cap - e.flow);
                if (!inQ[v]) {
                    inQ[v] = true;
                    q[qt++ % n] = v;
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

vector<int> minCostFlow(int s, int t, int maxf) {
    int dist[n];
    int curFlow[n];
    int prevEdge[n];
    int prevNode[n];
    int flow = 0, cost = 0;
    while (flow < maxf) {
        bellmanFord(s, dist, prevNode, prevEdge, curFlow);
        if (dist[t] == INT_MAX) break;
        int df = min(curFlow[t], maxf - flow);
        flow += df;
        for (int v = t; v != s; v = prevNode[v]) {
            Edge &e = graph[prevNode[v]][prevEdge[v]];
            e.flow += df;
            graph[v][e.rev].flow -= df;
            cost += df * e.cost;
        }
    }
    return {flow, cost};
}

void solve() {
    int N, M, K, C, D;
    cin >> N >> M >> K >> C >> D;
    int pos[N];
    memset(pos, 0, sizeof(pos));
    for (int i = 0; i < K; i++) {
        int x;
        cin >> x;
        pos[x - 1]++;
    }
    int T = 100;
    n = (T + 1) * N + 2;
    graph.resize(n);
    // add edges as in Java code (without reading M edges)
    for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
        if (pos[i] > 0) addEdge(0, i + 1, pos[i], 0);
    }
    for (int i = 0; i < T; i++) {
        for (int j = 0; j < N; j++) {
            addEdge(1 + i * N + j, 1 + (i + 1) * N + j, K, 0);
        }
    }
    for (int i = 0; i <= T; i++) {
        for (int j = 1; j <= K; j++) {
            addEdge(1 + i * N, (T + 1) * N + 1, 1, C * i);
        }
    }
    vector<int> res = minCostFlow(0, (T + 1) * N + 1, K);
    cerr << res[0] << endl;
    cout << res[1] << endl;
}

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    clock_t start = clock();
    solve();
    clock_t end = clock();
    cerr << "Time used: " << (double)(end - start) / CLOCKS_PER_SEC << " s." << endl;
    return 0;
}
